# routeros_zerotier_peer_hint (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_zerotier_peer_hint" "hint" {
  identity = "example"
  instance = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the peer the hint applies to, i.e. its ZeroTier address / public identity as listed in `/zerotier/peer`.
- `instance` (String) The ZeroTier instance the hint is installed on.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `addresses` (Set of String) Transport addresses the peer should be contacted on. The console confirms this is a comma separated list. The exact accepted notation of a single element (`ip/port`) could not be observed - no peers are known on RouterOS 7.23 and the console performs no value check on this attribute.
- `comment` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/zerotier/peer/hint get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_zerotier_peer_hint.hint "*1"
```
